clause: StudioSelectionSet core: combine modes + anti-alias + per-tool feather [STU-RAS-017]

scope.summary: Implement the single canonical StudioSelectionSet (14.3) selection core that all selection tools produce/refine/consume — no per-tool bespoke selection representation. Expose the shared combine modes New / Add / Subtract / Intersect (both explicit control and modifier keys), a document-wide default anti-alias toggle, and per-tool feather. Backend selection state + shared on-canvas selection surface consumed by every selection-tool MT.
expected_tests: live: build a selection then Add/Subtract/Intersect a second region and confirm the resulting StudioSelectionSet mask
argus: selection overlay snapshot + combine-mode toolbar author_ids
test: anti-alias toggle + per-tool feather applied to selection edge

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Selections: combine modes, anti-alias & feather

risk_if_missed: Each selection tool forks its own selection type; combine modes/feather inconsistent (dedup violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
